title: Engaging app which is actually helping
body: My son is 11 and autistic and we’ve used different apps and tools in the past to help with basic personal care which have never worked. I’m not going to lie, it’s still really difficult but with Joon we are able to be very specific with the important things, customise everything and adjust things without messing around on a computer. When he’s having a hard day I can delete the tasks which seem overwhelming but he still has a chance to earn coins. What I like most about the app is the engagement through a game. He likes to take care of the little creatures and so is not just a list of chores. I would recommend this app to other parents and be aware that introducing these kind of tools takes time and patience.
author: Lexandjo

title: For ANY kid
body: My two boys (8 and 10) love it. I suddenly have so much less hassle to let them do the things they need to do!! It’s a great overview with tasks and I can make it for anything. I love it that I can also give them tasks such as “give a compliment to someone”. Wonderful.

title: It’s an expensive trap

title: Kids environment not working
body: After installing everything from the parent side of things, it was quite a disappointment to learn that the kids side of the app just keeps showing the introduction video on loop, but doesn’t give you the option to continue or even to close the video. Feels like a scam this.
